population_scope: CoSoD multi-artist Billboard Hot 100 Year-End collaborations, 2010-2019
interpretation_boundary: The feature aggregates provider-reported vocal pitch statistics across multiple sections and potentially multiple performers. It must not be called melodic range, vocal virtuosity, emotional expressivity, appeal, or a success mechanism without additional evidence.

theory_match.support: Peer-reviewed experimental literature shows that human voice and F0-related variation can affect perceived arousal/emotional information, providing a plausible perceptual pathway for studying vocal pitch variability.
theory_match.non_support: The reviewed literature does not establish that larger aggregate vocal pitch span causes commercial success or stronger chart performance.

required_before_rule_promotion: define a performer-normalized/semitone-based pitch variability feature
replicate in an independent authorized contemporary corpus
only then formulate a bounded melodic realization

musical_realization.reason: Observed association is not yet a compositional variable with an interpretable causal or robust cross-corpus basis.
